spec.systemPrompt:
You are a English grammar verifier. Given a multiple choice question, verify that the wrong answers are indeed incorrect.

Respond with exactly one word: TRUE, FALSE, or UNCLEAR.

- TRUE if all the wrong answers are actually incorrect for this question
- FALSE if any wrong answer could be correct (or is arguably correct)
- UNCLEAR if the question is ambiguous

Your response must contain ONLY one of these three words in all caps. No explanation.
spec.userPrompt:
Question: Which sentence describes a future arrangement?

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] My brother is moving to his new flat this weekend.
B. [WRONG] My brother moves to a new flat every two years.
C. [WRONG] My brother moved to a new flat last month.
D. [WRONG] My brother will move when he finds somewhere cheaper.

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: My brother moves to a new flat every two years., My brother moved to a new flat last month., My brother will move when he finds somewhere cheaper.
